description_en: Queries the five most recent download tasks for SQL query results in a specified AnalyticDB for MySQL Lakehouse Edition (3.0) cluster
description_zh: 查看目标AnalyticDB MySQL湖仓版（3.0）集群中最近5次的SQL查询下载任务列表
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-download-records --db-cluster-id amv-8vb6ha79k6e0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDownloadRecords

parameters.description_en:
The cluster ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the details of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Lakehouse Edition (3.0) clusters in a specific region, including the cluster ID.
parameters.description_zh:
